answer: Cost first: each submission posts a review stake, a 10% spot check re-runs the work on a second auditor that shares no route with the first, and duplicates are caught by replaying the task id rather than by matching names. Take 200 answers landing on one atlas node: the farm pays 200 stakes plus 20 spot checks, and one replayed task id voids the batch. The benefit arrives only after that stake clears, so the voyage from signup to first payout runs 30 days and the nebula of cheap batches never repays its own stakes.
